cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_cotton = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:cotton }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = cotton
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_cotton_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_naval_supplies_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_naval_supplies_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_naval_supplies_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_naval_supplies_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_naval_supplies_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_naval_supplies_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_naval_supplies_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_naval_supplies_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_firearms = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:firearms }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = firearms
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_firearms_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fine_cloth_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fine_cloth_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fine_cloth_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fine_cloth_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_liquor = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:liquor }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = liquor
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_liquor_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_masonry = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:masonry }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = masonry
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_masonry_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_coal = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:coal }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = coal
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_coal_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_iron = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:iron }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = iron
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = lead
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_lead_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_silk_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_silk_ledger_produced_by_market }

			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {

				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_silk_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_silk_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_silk_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_silk_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}

			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fiber_crops_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_ivory = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:ivory }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = ivory
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_ivory_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

		}

		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_amber_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_saltpeter = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:saltpeter }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = saltpeter
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saltpeter_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_saffron_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saffron_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saffron_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_saffron_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_saffron_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saffron_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_saffron_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_pepper = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:pepper }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = pepper
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_pepper_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fish_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fish_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fish_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_wheat = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:wheat }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = wheat
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_olives = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:olives }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
				good = olives
			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_olives_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_market_produced_row_good_fruit = {
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		set_local_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_is_produced_in_market value = 0 }
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_produced_in_market = goods:fruit }
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_is_produced_in_market value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_market_country

			cbp_read_void_economy_record = {
				country = scope:cbp_us10_ui_market_country
				market = scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope

			}

			scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
				change_local_variable = {
					name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
					add = scope:cbp_us00_produced
				}
			}
		}
	}

	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_ledger_produced_by_market_value
			value = local_var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_ledger_produced_by_market_accumulator
		}
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_ledger_produced_by_market value = scope:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_ledger_produced_by_market_value }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_produced_by_market value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_ledger_produced_by_market }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_visible value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_visibility_source value = 0 }

		if = {
			limit = { var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_is_produced_in_market > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_visibility_source value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_market_stock > 0
					var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_country_stock > 0
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_visible value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_fruit_visibility_source value = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_capture_selected_market_produced_by_market = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_country
	cbp_us10_ui_clear_all_market_produced_rows = yes
	set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_countries_present_in_market_count value = 0 }

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = gui_cbp_us10_ui_selected_market }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = gui_cbp_us10_ui_selected_market
			save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope
			scope:cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_scope = { save_temporary_scope_as = cbp_market_country_cache_market }
			cbp_rebuild_countries_present_in_market = yes

			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable_list = cbp_countries_present_in_market }
				every_in_global_list = {
					variable = cbp_countries_present_in_market
					scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
						set_variable = { name = gui_cbp_us10_ui_countries_present_in_market_count value = { value = var:gui_cbp_us10_ui_countries_present_in_market_count add = 1 } }
					}
				}
			}

			cbp_us10_ui_capture_all_market_produced_rows = yes
		}
	}
}

cbp_us10_ui_prepare_current_market_table_for_production_ui = {
	cbp_us10_ui_prepare_current_market_table = yes
	cbp_us10_ui_capture_selected_market_produced_by_market = yes
	scope:cbp_us10_ui_country = {
		debug_log = "ModeU5 US-10-UI FILTER market_index=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_index').GetValue|0] market_count=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_market_count').GetValue|0] selected_market_available=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_selected_market_available').GetValue|0] countries_present=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_countries_present_in_market_count').GetValue|0] vanilla_rows=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_produced_positive_rows').GetValue|0] stock_fallback_rows=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_stock_fallback_rows').GetValue|0] wheat_flag=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_is_produced_in_market').GetValue|0] wheat_ledger=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_wheat_ledger_produced_by_market').GetValue|2] iron_flag=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_is_produced_in_market').GetValue|0] iron_ledger=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_iron_ledger_produced_by_market').GetValue|2] cloth_flag=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_cloth_is_produced_in_market').GetValue|0] cloth_ledger=[THIS.GetVariable('gui_cbp_us10_ui_cloth_ledger_produced_by_market').GetValue|2]"
	}
}
